hooks.text: 低等级硬打会被严惩，需要混用战斗、潜行和对话，并同步管理金币、生命、盟友与理智。
hooks.excerpt: Players may find it much more useful to use a combination of combat, stealth and/or dialogue to deal with the inhabitants of the nether realms. In fact, the game will punish you severely if you try to fight everything as a low level character, so try to manage your gold, health, alliances and sanity carefully as you traverse the Great Abyss.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 地表探索采用2D俯视地图，进入地牢后切换为3D第一人称，两种视角构成复古CRPG空间感。
hooks.excerpt: Outside of dungeons, you see your character from the top down in a 2D display of the map. Whereas, in dungeons, the view changes to a 3D, first person perspective.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 深渊居民可通过联盟加入队伍，而新的盟约需要找到并阅读正确的书籍才能建立。
hooks.excerpt: Alliances allow you to have some of the various denizens of the Great Abyss join your party, and help to fight other enemies. New alliances can be formed during the game by finding and reading the right books.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

baseline.message: 首期基线，暂无可比趋势。
